daily_rates_ck.name: daily_rates_ck
daily_rates_ck.value: ("daily_rates"."rate_centavos" is null or "daily_rates"."rate_centavos" >= 0) and "daily_rates"."min_stay" between 1 and 365 and ("daily_rates"."max_stay" is null or "daily_rates"."max_stay" between "daily_rates"."min_stay" and 365)

policies_values_ck.name: policies_values_ck
policies_values_ck.value: "policies"."guarantee_value" between 0 and 10000 and "policies"."late_cancel_value" between 0 and 10000 and "policies"."no_show_value" between 0 and 10000

policies_hours_ck.name: policies_hours_ck
policies_hours_ck.value: ("policies"."free_cancel_hours" is null or "policies"."free_cancel_hours" between 0 and 8760) and "policies"."hold_hours" between 0 and 720

rate_plans_parent_ck.name: rate_plans_parent_ck
rate_plans_parent_ck.value: ("rate_plans"."type" = 'STANDARD' and "rate_plans"."parent_id" is null) or ("rate_plans"."type" <> 'STANDARD' and "rate_plans"."parent_id" is not null)
